parameters.name: ProgramId
parameters.description: The ID of the playlist. You can obtain the ID from the ProgramId parameter in the response of the [AddPlaylistItems](~~2848078~~) operation.

parameters.name: ProgramItemIds
parameters.description: The IDs of the playlist items. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). If you specify this parameter, only the information about the specified items is returned. If you leave this parameter empty, the information about all items in the playlist is returned.
